name: r1104_ep_turning
hookRule: Can a wheelchair turn around in your plan?
script: Can a wheelchair turn all the way around in your plan? There is one number that decides it.
Sixty inches. That is the diameter of the circle that has to stay clear, so a wheelchair can make a full turn. Check it in every accessible room.
Comment REACH, and I'll send you the free one page cheat sheet with all five.
